title: CRM Marketing Executive
description:
CRM Marketing Executive

Location: Guildford

Salary: £30,000 - £38,000

Permanent Full-time - fully office-based

We are looking for an experienced CRM Marketing Executive to join a growing eCommerce team in Guildford.

This is a hands-on role with a strong focus on CRM, email marketing, customer journeys and commercial analysis. You'll be responsible for managing customer communications across multiple eCommerce websites and brands, with the aim of increasing customer engagement, retention and revenue.

It's an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys combining creative campaign execution with data, analysis and optimisation, and who wants to have a genuine commercial impact.

The Role

You will take ownership of the day-to-day email marketing activity, from planning and building campaigns through to testing, scheduling and analysing results.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the email marketing calendar across multiple eCommerce websites and brands
- Planning, building, testing and scheduling email campaigns
- Managing and optimising automated customer journeys, including welcome, post-purchase, re-engagement and promotional campaigns
- Developing customer segmentation to improve relevance and campaign performance
- Monitoring engagement, deliverability and customer behaviour
- Working closely with eCommerce and marketing teams to support promotions, product launches and seasonal activity
- Monitoring key CRM metrics including revenue, conversion, click-through and open rates
- Analysing campaign performance and making clear recommendations for future activity
- Running tests across subject lines, content, creative, offers, segmentation and send times

About You

We're looking for someone with previous experience in CRM, email marketing, eCommerce or digital marketing, together with strong analytical and commercial skills.

You will ideally have:
- Experience creating and managing email marketing campaigns
- Experience with email automation or customer journey platforms
- A good understanding of customer segmentation, retention and lifecycle marketing
- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with sales and marketing data
- Good working knowledge of Excel or similar reporting tools
- The ability to turn data into clear, commercially focused recommendations
- A commercially focused approach and an understanding of how digital marketing contributes to revenue.

Desirable Experience

Experience with any of the following would be advantageous:
- Ometria or a similar CRM/email marketing platform
- Working within an eCommerce environment
- Affiliate marketing networks or agencies
- Shopify or another eCommerce platform
- Google Analytics or similar web analytics platforms
- Creating reports or dashboards using Excel
- Working across multiple brands or websites.

The Person

You'll be commercially aware, analytical and naturally curious, with an interest in understanding not just what the numbers are doing, but why.

You'll be highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines, while also being proactive enough to suggest improvements rather than simply following instructions.

The successful candidate will be confident working independently, but equally comfortable collaborating with wider eCommerce and marketing teams and communicating findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

Why Apply?

This is a great opportunity to join a commercially focused eCommerce environment where CRM is seen as a key driver of customer engagement, retention and revenue.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of campaigns, analyse their impact and continually improve performance through testing and optimisation.

If you're an experienced CRM or email marketing professional looking for your next challenge in Guildford, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV for more information.

title: Ferrari Marketing Executive
description:
Ferrari ownership is about far more than the car itself. It is an experience shaped by emotion, anticipation, personal connection and attention to every detail. As a Ferrari Marketing Executive, you will play a central role in bringing that experience to life, ensuring every client interaction reflects the exceptional standards, care and attention synonymous with the Ferrari brand. Working closely with Sales, After Sales and Marketing, you will help create memorable experiences both within the dealership and through a programme of exclusive events and client activities.

The Role

As Ferrari Marketing Executive, you will take ownership of the customer journey, shaping how clients and prospects experience the brand from their first interaction through to vehicle delivery and beyond. You will be a highly visible and engaging presence within the dealership, building trusted client relationships, creating a welcoming and premium showroom environment, hosting experiences and events, and helping to foster a strong and connected Ferrari community.

You will play an active role in the planning, organisation and delivery of local events and customer initiatives, bringing ideas and initiative to help shape engaging experiences. Working closely with the Marketing Manager, you will support event concepts, guest selection and invitations, supplier coordination, budgets, on-the-day execution and post-event follow-up. You will help use these opportunities to engage existing clients, attract new prospects and strengthen long-term customer loyalty, while ensuring every activity is delivered to the highest standards and in line with Ferrari's brand guidelines.

You will also take ownership of the dealership's social media presence, creating and coordinating engaging content that showcases Ferrari, our clients, events, experiences and community. Working within Ferrari's brand guidelines, you will manage the social media calendar, coordinate content and monitor engagement, ensuring our digital presence reflects the same level of quality and exclusivity as the in-person Ferrari experience.

In addition, you will oversee relevant digital marketing activity, including website content, email campaigns and paid digital initiatives, supporting customer acquisition, engagement and retention. You will monitor the effectiveness of marketing and event activity, evaluating customer engagement, acquisition, loyalty and return on investment to continually identify opportunities for improvement.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organised, creative and naturally personable individual to become a key ambassador for Ferrari, creating exceptional experiences, developing lasting client relationships and helping to shape the next chapter of our Ferrari community.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.

title: Head of External Affairs
company: Murray McIntosh Recruitment Consultancy - Agency - Permanent
description:
Murray McIntosh is proud to partner with Future Biogas, one of the UK's leading developers, owners and operators of anaerobic digestion and biomethane infrastructure. Operating 11 sites nationwide and backed by major infrastructure investors, the business is helping corporates decarbonise through renewable gas today while developing the next generation of carbon-negative energy projects.

As the business enters an exciting new phase of growth, Future Biogas is creating a Head of External Affairs role to strengthen its influence across government, regulators, industry and the wider stakeholder landscape.

This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead a new function at the centre of one of the UK's most innovative clean energy businesses.

The Opportunity

Working closely with the CEO and wider senior leadership, you will ensure Future Biogas is represented in the right conversations, building relationships that support both the business and the wider energy transition.

You'll sit at the intersection of policy, communications, business development and commercial strategy, helping to shape how Future Biogas engages with Government ministers and officials, regulators and policymakers, industry associations, corporate stakeholders and key partners across energy, agriculture and sustainability.

The role will operate with a high degree of autonomy, responsible for managing the external affairs function and associated budget.
- Lead the external affairs, development of FB's parliamentary profile and government stakeholder engagement activities.
- Create the relationships needed to help identify and influence policy developments across government, quasi-governmental organisations and NGO's that impact the business.
- Provide strategic advice on political and external affairs and reputational issues in conjunction with Policy, Comms and other FB teams as relevant.
- Support business development, planning and growth opportunities through effective stakeholder engagement.

We're interested in speaking with individuals who can demonstrate:
- Degree or equivalent experience in Public Affairs, Politics, Communications, Business or a related discipline
- Proven experience in public affairs, government relations or policy development within a related industry
- Excellent influencing, communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong commercial awareness and strategic thinking
- Experience of leading and developing small, high-performing teams

Most importantly, you'll be a natural relationship-builder who enjoys opening doors, creating opportunities and bringing the right people together.

You'll combine strategic thinking with strong political awareness and have the credibility to engage confidently with senior stakeholders both internally and externally.

What's on Offer?
- A newly created leadership role with significant exposure to CEO and executive team and the opportunity to build and shape a function
- Competitive salary with performance-related bonus and excellent benefits package

Location: Future Biogas' headquarters are based in Guildford, with a new office opening within the Surrey Research Park. With a hybrid working model, the business already attracts talent from London and the South East, supported by strong rail links and shuttle transport.

If you're excited by the prospect of helping shape the future of renewable energy, carbon removals and UK sustainability policy, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Communications & Marketing Officer
description:
Summary

Are you a creative storyteller? Do you like creating inspiring content across a range of platforms using different media? If so, we're looking for a Senior Communications and Marketing Officer to plan and lead our communications and marketing for Munstead Wood. This is an exciting time to join a new National Trust project, with the opportunity to shape and develop the storytelling for this special place from the very beginning.

Salary: £17,620.20 per annum pro rated (£29,367 FTE)

Contract Duration: Fixed term until 31st October 2028

Working Pattern: You will work 22.5 hours per week, with a flexible working pattern. Your hours may vary depending on operational requirements, but evening/weekend work will be rare. Where this is required, time off in lieu will be provided.

Interviews will be held on Monday 26th October at Munstead Wood

If you have any queries or would like to learn more about this role please email: .uk What it's like to work here

Munstead Wood is an exciting recent acquisition for the National Trust. The personal home of garden designer and prolific content creator Gertrude Jekyll, it was designed in collaboration with Edwin Lutyens.

Based at the property in Godalming, you'll be part of a small on-property team looking after the day-to-day needs and running of the property, which is not currently open to the public. There is also an active project team working through the design and planning phase, developing detailed proposals and fundraising to support this work. As part of the on-property team, you'll develop and support communications around this exciting and evolving project. You will need to be able to work regularly on-site.

What you'll be doing

You'll create a dynamic communications plan for this evolving project, leading the development and delivery of original content to support its key messages and themes across a range of communication channels. You'll bring fresh, creative ideas to life, telling the stories of this inspirational place of creativity in ways that connect with audiences around the world.

This is a dynamic and collaborative role, working with stakeholders from across the organisation and externally. You'll bring together diverse expertise to create high-quality content across multiple strands of activity, ensuring work is delivered efficiently and to a consistently high standard.

Who we're looking for

We'd love to hear from you if you have:
- experience creating captivating content using different media across all platforms, and for a range of audiences
- the ability to work collaboratively and flexibly, both independently and as part of a team
- experience building relationships and working with internal and external stakeholders
- experience building dynamic communications plans for evolving projects
- strong proof-reading skills

The package

The National Trust has the motto 'For everyone, for ever' at its heart. We're working hard to create an inclusive culture, where everyone feels they belong. It's important that our people reflect and represent the diversity of the communities and audiences we serve. We welcome and value difference, so when we say we're for everyone, we want everyone to be welcome in our teams too.
- Substantial pension scheme of up to 10% basic salary
- Free entry to National Trust places for you, a guest and your children (under 18)
- Rental deposit loan scheme
- Season ticket loan
- EV car lease scheme (for roles that meet the salary criteria)
- Perks at work discounts such as gym memberships, shopping discount codes, cinema discounts
- Holiday allowance up to 32 days relating to length of service, plus holiday purchase scheme, subject to meeting minimum criteria.
- Flexible working whenever possible
- Employee assistance programme
- Free parking at most Trust places
